title: Ilbeyli v2.0 Control Card
author: Abdurrahman
summary: High-performance STM32F411 microcontroller board designed for motion control.
details:
The Ilbeyli v2.0 control card is a powerful ARM Cortex-M4 based board.

Config:

var board = new ControlBoard {
    MCU = "STM32F411",
    Drivers = ["TB6600", "DRV8825"],
    Display = "Nextion"
};
